annotation.title_clean: Council of Europe Framework Convention on Artificial Intelligence and Human Rights, Democracy and the Rule of Law: European Parliament legislative resolution of 11 March 2026 (consent to conclusion)
annotation.title_en: Council of Europe Framework Convention on Artificial Intelligence and Human Rights, Democracy and the Rule of Law: European Parliament legislative resolution of 11 March 2026 (consent to conclusion)
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union (C series)
named_instruments_referenced: Council of Europe Framework Convention on AI
annotation.summary_en: European Parliament legislative resolution of 11 March 2026, published in the Official Journal, giving consent to the Council decision on the EU's conclusion of the Council of Europe Framework Convention on AI and Human Rights, Democracy and the Rule of Law (CETS 225). It contains no robotics-specific content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Parliament consents to the EU's conclusion of the Council of Europe Framework Convention on AI (CETS 225)
Recommendation from IMCO and LIBE committees (A10-0007/2026)
President to forward position to Council, Commission, Member States and Council of Europe Secretary General
